question: Calculate the duration of each track, classify them as short, medium, or long, output the minimum and maximum time for each kind (in minutes) and the total revenue for each category, group by the category.
sql:
WITH track_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MIN(Milliseconds) AS min_ms,
    MAX(Milliseconds) AS max_ms,
    AVG(Milliseconds) AS avg_ms
  FROM Track
),
boundaries AS (
  SELECT 
    min_ms,
    max_ms,
    avg_ms,
    (min_ms + avg_ms) / 2.0 AS short_boundary,
    (avg_ms + max_ms) / 2.0 AS medium_boundary
  FROM track_stats
),
track_with_category AS (
  SELECT 
    t.TrackId,
    t.Milliseconds,
    b.short_boundary,
    b.medium_boundary,
    CASE 
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= b.short_boundary THEN 'Short'
      WHEN t.Milliseconds <= b.medium_boundary THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Long'
    END AS category
  FROM Track t
  CROSS JOIN boundaries b
)
SELECT 
  category,
  ROUND(MIN(Milliseconds / 60000.0), 2) AS min_minutes,
  ROUND(MAX(Milliseconds / 60000.0), 2) AS max_minutes,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(il.UnitPrice * il.Quantity), 0), 2) AS total_revenue
FROM track_with_category twc
LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine il ON twc.TrackId = il.TrackId
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY 
  CASE category 
    WHEN 'Short' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Long' THEN 3 
  END
